Where the reserves sit

WHAT TO CHECK NEXT

Before treating this as an exit

  • Get an executable quote for your exact amount.
  • Check the route, fees and price impact in that quote.
  • Check active liquidity, token restrictions and taxes.

High volume does not prove deep liquidity or organic demand. This tool does not check whether a token is safe to sell.

Sources, calculations and limits

CoinGecko supplies pool reserves, volume, price changes and transaction counts. PoolCheck calculates position-to-reserve ratios, turnover and reserve shares.

positionPct = positionUsd / reserveUsd * 100;
turnover = volume24hUsd / reserveUsd;

Position / reserves is a size comparison, not slippage, price impact or expected loss. Volume covers the preceding 24 hours; reserves are a current snapshot. Concentrated liquidity, routing, fees, taxes and token restrictions are not modeled. Counts refer to swaps, not unique people.

Page 1 only, up to 20 pools. Duplicate pool IDs are removed; exact token identity is checked. Missing data is never replaced with zero. Saved examples are historical, not current quotes.

Open source response

Keyless access has shared limits and is intended for prototypes. A production service needs a suitable API plan and stronger traffic controls.
